$comment: Filler catalogue for the Omen storefront. Read by scripts/seed-catalogue.ts (run 1.1). Every product gets `seedTag` so the script can wipe and re-create. `price`, `compareAtPrice`, and `inventory` on a product apply to every variant; entries in `variants` override them for one combination of option values. A product with no `options` is a single-variant product (Shopify's Default Title). `images.motif` is a hint for the procedural art generator; `images.count` is how many portrait 4:5 images to attach. Real products replace this file through the same script.

products.title: Witness Tee
products.description: Heavyweight cotton tee with the serpent mark at the chest and WITNESS printed inside the collar, where only you can read it.

products.title: Sighting Long Sleeve
products.description: Long-sleeve tee with one sighting record printed down the left sleeve: date, time, bearing, duration, and no conclusion.

details: Relaxed fit; size down for a closer cut

products.title: Static Socks
